_doc: Helper agents that write the data (no APIs). models: family (writer, checker and judge of an item are of different families when possible), reasoning effort, and who launches it (codex: the user's Codex; claude: Claude Code subagents). write: share of scenarios per writer (a batch started with --writers keeps its own in writers.json). check: round-trip interpreters. judge: naturalness and reply judges (each item goes to one of another family than its writer and interpreter). per: items per in-NN.txt (fichas, situations, phrases, answers).
